text1: With the fury of Manticore, aggression of Retribution, panache of Eradicator, bullishness of Mule and contriteness of Buffalo, these powers unite to make a pirate battleship! A fast, fragile platform for delivering a withering rain of dakka.
Provides a massive boost to forward mobility with a long fade-out period.

An overcharged mining laser stacked with a series of focusing lenses and loaded with sacrificial lasing mediums that burn out in use, fed in from a magazine. The weapon is infamous for being difficult to maintain due to its internals occasionally outright melting in use. The cooling system, if not stripped for parts by an enterprising newbie, eats almost as much energy as powering the laser.

A pirate capital ship armament that became popular not long after the collapse. A battery of three drake weapons, combined into a single mount and sharing a cooling jacket ripped from the reactor housing of an Atlas. Due to lack of individual elevation and traverse within the turret housing, the lasers emitted by a drake battery travel adjacent to each other and fail to concentrate their damage on target.
Provides a strong boost in forward movement and strafe speed while reducing turn rate.
